answer: Farming becomes a cedar bet on surviving 107 epochs of grading, and every meadow settlement recomputes the trellis schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 107 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
